_notes: StreamDiffusionV2 1.3B (Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B causal DMD v2v), upstream @ 6961a5c, venv + weights: deploy/setup_sdv2_env.sh.
Wan prompts are scene descriptions (T2V captions), not edit instructions: describe the subject facing the camera + setting + style.
512x512 (multiple of 16; 1024 tokens/latent frame), 2 steps = upstream's live default; 640x352 is the 16:9 alternative (880 tokens).
vae_type: lightvae (fast, default) | lightvae_taehv (fastest decode) | taehv (full Wan encoder + TAEHV, upstream --use_taehv) | lightvae_decode | wan (reference, slow).
text_encoder_device auto = GPU if UMT5 (11.4 GB) + 8 GB margin fit after the model loads, else CPU (prompt encoding a few s on CPU, cached on disk).
